objective: Close the first Wave 3 AI architecture slice: make provider health/capability state explicit and consumable without treating configured credentials as healthy generation.

criteria.promise: The provider registry exposes a deterministic health/capability result that distinguishes unavailable, configured, and ready generation paths.
Routing/selection never treats configured-only providers as verified healthy; local-only policy cannot select a cloud provider.
Focused tests cover ready/configured/unavailable, non-2xx/provider errors, and local-only routing without network calls.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect Intelligence.swift/provider registry and tests; run focused provider/router tests.
verification_gates.expected: State and capability semantics are explicit and stable.

verification_gates.procedure: Exercise deterministic fake providers and routing policy tests.
verification_gates.expected: Configured is not healthy and local-only excludes cloud routes.

verification_gates.procedure: Run focused AI tests and git diff --check.
verification_gates.expected: All focused tests pass with no real network dependency.

recon_evidence: Current provider registry, intelligence probe states, provider health cache, ModelRouting.swift, and focused routing/provider tests were inspected. Real MacBook provider availability remains a manual runtime gate, not an unresolved implementation question for this bounded slice.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Provider state and router decision table from current code/tests.
